units.source_text: 我赶忙捡起帽子，

en.t: I hurriedly picked up the hat,

units.source_text: 用指甲弹掉沾在上面的红土，对先生说：“先生，帽子掉了。”

en.t: flicked off the red clay stuck to it with my fingernail, and said to Sensei, “Sensei, your hat fell off.”

units.source_text: “谢谢。”

en.t: “Thank you.”

units.source_text: 先生欠身接过帽子时，

en.t: As Sensei bent forward and took the hat,

units.source_text: 问了我一个奇怪的问题。

en.t: he asked me a strange question.

units.source_text: “冒失地问一句，你家的财产很多吧？”

en.t: “Forgive me for asking so abruptly, but your family must have a good deal of property, mustn’t it?”

units.source_text: “不算很多。”

en.t: “Not what I would call a lot.”

units.source_text: “大概有多少呢？

en.t: “About how much is there?

units.source_text: 请原谅我这么问。”

en.t: Please forgive me for asking.”

units.source_text: “您问有多少财产？

en.t: “You mean how much property we have?

units.source_text: 只有山和田地，没有什么钱。”

en.t: There are only mountains and fields; there is hardly any money.”

units.source_text: 先生正式问起我家的经济状况，这还是第一次。

en.t: This was the first time Sensei had asked me directly about my family’s financial circumstances.

units.source_text: 我从来没问过先生的生计，自从认识先生，我就不明白先生为什么不出去做事。

en.t: I had never asked Sensei about his own livelihood, and ever since I had come to know him, I had not understood why he did not go out to work.

units.source_text: 后来这个疑问总是挥之不去，但是我又觉得对先生提出这种露骨的问题，未免造次，所以一直没敢问。

en.t: Later this question kept lingering in my mind, but I felt it would be too rude to put such a blunt question to Sensei, so I had never dared to ask.

units.source_text: 望着满眼绿叶，疲惫的眼睛得到了休息后，我忽然想起了这个问题。

en.t: After my tired eyes had rested on the green leaves all around me, the question suddenly came back to mind.

units.source_text: “先生呢，您有多少财产啊？”

en.t: “What about you, Sensei? How much property do you have?”

units.source_text: “你看我像个财主吗？”

en.t: “Do I look like a wealthy man to you?”

units.source_text: 先生平时衣着简朴，家里人口又少，故而也没有住大宅子。

en.t: Sensei usually dressed simply, and there were few people in his household, so he did not live in a large house.

units.source_text: 但是，他的生活却是很宽裕的，这一点即便不了解内情的我也看得很清楚。

en.t: Even so, his life was plainly comfortable, and that much was clear even to me, though I knew nothing of the details.

units.source_text: 总之，先生的生活虽说不上奢侈，也绝不是吝啬、拮据的。

en.t: In short, while Sensei’s way of living could not be called luxurious, it was certainly not stingy or cramped.

units.source_text: “大概是吧。”我说。

en.t: “I suppose so,” I said.

units.source_text: “我是有些钱，但绝不是财主。

en.t: “I do have some money, but I am certainly not a wealthy man.

units.source_text: 要是财主的话，就会盖更大的房子喽。”

en.t: If I were, I would build a bigger house.”
